tests/e2e/b6-erase.spec.ts.backend: fake, with the server's rules (cascade, erased ids refused with CVERA); Chromium and WebKit
cases: an erase takes the course off the server (unconditional delete, app version sent, id recorded) and leaves nothing of it in ps_crud, ps_oplog, ps_untyped, uploadRefusals or the views
offline, an erase leaves nothing here, unsent changes included; Impostazioni and Esci say the erase is still to reach the backup; with signal it completes, before the new course uploads
a course file of the same course replaces it on the server: old rows erased, the id accepted again, then the file's course uploaded
a full reset erases the backup's copy first; without signal it resets nothing
before the server records erased ids, the erase still deletes the course
an erase made before the server records erased ids is not repeated later (DI-B6-R2-1)
signing in with a course whose id was erased elsewhere uploads it, accepted again (DI-B6-R2-2)
accepting an erased id again waits for the server without holding the backup back: the refused upload is kept for Riprova, and sent once the id is accepted

tests/e2e/b6-erase-live.spec.ts.backend: the owner's development backend, synthetic test account 1; skipped without .env
cases: an erase takes the course and its rows off the server; the empty device stays empty once connected (the CVERA branch runs once the owner's migration is in)
an erase made with the backend out of reach leaves the server copy until Riprova, then erases it
the account's other phone drops the erased course, and its raw IndexedDB keeps nothing of it (fails with the compaction disabled: control run)
